title: 8+ years building and running production platforms.
subtitle: Digital payments, telecom and SaaS. Tap any role to see the full list of achievements.

items.summary: Lead a 6–10 member DevOps & Cloud team running 100+ Kubernetes clusters across AWS, GCP and Azure — and build Cosmic, our AIOps platform for workflows, Kubernetes and AI agents.
keyWins: Built Cosmic — an MCP gateway over 21+ DevOps tools and 100+ clusters, powering multi-tool workflows, a Kubernetes lens and AI agents.
Run VictoriaMetrics across 90+ Kubernetes clusters for scalable, low-cost, long-term metrics.
Cut cloud spend 13% across AWS, GCP & Azure through right-sizing and storage optimization.
bullets: Lead & mentor a 6–10 member DevOps & Cloud Engineering team — technical direction, code reviews, hiring, and end-to-end delivery of the internal DevOps/AIOps platform.

Architected and developed Cosmic, a Go-based MCP (Model Context Protocol) gateway federating 21+ infrastructure integrations (AWS, Kubernetes, Prometheus, PagerDuty, Jenkins, Graylog, VoIP, InfluxDB, Elasticsearch) through one RBAC-governed endpoint that works with public MCP clients such as Claude and Cursor.

Enabled AI-driven self-service operations — AWS cost & usage intelligence plus production incident triage, diagnosis and remediation through natural-language interfaces, reducing manual toil and MTTR.

Designed a Go-based workflow automation engine inside Cosmic — engineers can create any number of workflows that chain DevOps tools through their MCP, with an LLM-assisted builder, human approvals, scheduling, credential management and version history.
Engineered AI agents on Cosmic that work on an engineer's behalf — incident triage, infrastructure health checks, CAB (Change Advisory Board) scheduling and running workflows on request.

Built internal engineering platforms Prism (Kubernetes lens for multi-cluster visibility and troubleshooting), Chronos (centralized alerting & observability) and Astrosync (scheduled OS/package patching with safe rollback).
Deployed and operated VictoriaMetrics across 90+ Kubernetes clusters for high-cardinality, long-term metrics storage at lower cost.
Implemented progressive delivery with Argo Rollouts — canary and blue-green deployments with automated analysis and instant rollback.
Automated AWS provisioning with Terraform and managed self-hosted EKS clusters, using Graviton nodes, spot instances and autoscaling.
Engineered a high-throughput telemetry pipeline on OpenTelemetry & Kafka — logs & traces in ClickHouse, metrics in VictoriaMetrics — horizontally scalable and highly available.
Deployed and tuned self-hosted ClickHouse on Kubernetes for high-throughput log & trace ingestion and fast queries.
Autoscaled ingestion workloads with KEDA on Kafka consumer lag, absorbing traffic spikes and eliminating over-provisioning.
Built reusable Terraform & Terragrunt modules for consistent infrastructure across AWS, GCP & Azure.
Automated complex multi-step operational and data pipelines with Argo Workflows.
Drove a 13% reduction in cloud spend across AWS, GCP & Azure via right-sizing, workload optimization and zstd compression / lifecycle policies.
Introduced chaos engineering with Litmus Chaos in CI/CD — node failures, pod evictions and network faults validated before release.

keyWins: Migrated 50+ microservices from Ali Cloud to AWS (Kubernetes/EKS) — 25% lower operating cost.

Shipped a Kubernetes Operator (CRDs) that automates HPA patching.
bullets: Led cross-functional DevOps & cloud initiatives — technical leadership, project management and delivery governance — achieving a 20% reduction in project completion time.
Directed the migration of 50+ microservices from Ali Cloud to AWS, architecting cloud-native deployment on Kubernetes/EKS and delivering a 25% reduction in operational costs.
Designed and developed a Release Engineering UI to streamline deployment and release management — 30% reduction in manual operational tasks.
Implemented APM and application monitoring with error-triggered alerting, contributing to 99% infrastructure uptime.
Designed and deployed a Kubernetes Operator using Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) to automate HPA patching across Kubernetes workloads.
Integrated AI-powered anomaly detection into monitoring, contributing to a 15% reduction in critical incidents.

Automated deployments for 15+ microservices — 25% faster deploys.
bullets: Performed capacity planning and infrastructure scaling analysis, achieving a 20% reduction in infrastructure costs.
Automated deployment processes for 15+ microservices, reducing deployment execution time by 25%.
Optimized cloud infrastructure through resource allocation and automation, improving resource utilization by 30%.
Owned production and development system availability, supporting 99.9% uptime across critical environments.
Recognized for JVM hygiene automation across multiple microservices.
